copy.curiosityHook: Can an audacious artistic dream survive an unforgiving trek through the heart of the rainforest?
copy.description: Driven by an ambition to build an opera house in the Peruvian Amazon, dreamer Fitzcarraldo mounts a daring expedition into an uncharted jungle territory to secure a fortune in rubber.
copy.vibeSummary: An immersive, thoughtful adventure with steady momentum, tailored for dedicated solo viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Director Werner Herzog channels monumental ambition into a sprawling, immersive drama where culture and untamed wilderness collide.

allowedMaterial: Fitzcarraldo's dream of building an opera house in Iquitos
The quest to harvest rubber in an unexplored rainforest region to finance the project
Werner Herzog's direction and dramatic adventure tone
excludedMaterial: Details of late-stage expedition setbacks or successes
Specific outcomes of the rubber enterprise and opera house endeavor
